about: Searching from the command palette (Cmd-K) while message search is unreachable, then pressing Enter once it is back. Staged: the page's fetch refuses /api/search until the step before Enter lets it through again; everything else is the app as it is.

steps.eval: (() => { const f = document.querySelector('input[role=combobox][aria-label=Search]') || document.activeElement; f.focus(); const set = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(HTMLInputElement.prototype, 'value').set; set.call(f, 'like me to do'); f.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); return document.activeElement === f; })()
